The repeated warnings about 'MORE THAN ONE Configuration' (Debug default vs Release global) were noted but not investigated as a root cause. The agent's proposed fix (removing $(TargetFramework) from paths) addresses a symptom rather than the actual root cause. The investigation was thorough in its approach but followed the wrong trail, leading to an incorrect diagnosis and fix.
